candidates.label: Check in calculated machine and human projections
evidence: CAL-PROP-0001 requires deterministic checked-in human projections and machine comparison; canonical events can additionally calculate reviewable machine state.

candidates.label: Check in human projections and calculate machine state on demand
evidence: This preserves the proposal's human-continuation obligation while reducing duplicated calculated machine files.

candidates.label: Calculate all projections on demand and check in none
evidence: CAL-PROP-0001 requires checked-in deterministic human projections for continuation and exact comparison.
rejectionReasons: On-demand-only projection removes the required checked-in human continuation surface and cannot satisfy the proposal's exact-byte comparison obligation.

candidates.label: Defer calculated-projection policy
evidence: Deferral blocks final repository layout and projection acceptance tests.

candidates.label: Stop calculated-projection design
evidence: Stopping terminates projection design without mutation.
